label: Dataset ID
description: Dataset specification identifier
missing_rule: Always populated from the dataset specification
notes: System variable injected during harmonisation

label: Dataset name
description: Dataset specification name
missing_rule: Always populated from the dataset specification
notes: System variable injected during harmonisation

label: Participant ID
description: Study-specific participant identifier
missing_rule: Should uniquely identify a participant within a dataset
notes: Required core identifier

label: Wave
description: Study wave or collection occasion
missing_rule: Use NA when no repeated-wave structure is available
notes: Required core longitudinal field

label: Year data were collected
description: The year that data collection occured.

label: RCT arm
description: Trial arm the participant was allocated to, for datasets from randomised controlled trials
missing_rule: Use NA if not applicable (i.e., not a randomised trial)
notes: Record the study's published arm labels, using Control for the control/usual-care arm; include as a covariate when pooling RCT cohorts (see DR-0001 for which experimental designs are included)

label: Age in years
description: Participant age at the observation in years
missing_rule: Use NA when age cannot yet be derived
notes: Continuous age measure

label: Sex
description: Harmonised participant sex/gender field
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived
notes: Use explicit lookup tables when recoding source categories

label: Country
description: Participant's location at observation point
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived
notes: If not in dataset, assume based on where data were collected

label: Australian State
description: Australian State data were collected
missing_rule: Use NA if not applicable (i.e., not an Australian dataset) and Unknown if cannot be derived.
notes: Used to report state-relevant findings to NSW DoE

label: Ethnicity
description: Participant ethnicity
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived

label: Participant indigenous status
description: Would this participant be considered indigenous for their country
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived

label: Minority
description: Indicator for if the participant ethnicity indicates they are a minority within their country/region
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived

label: Area-level SES
description: Socioeconomic status for the area the participant lives
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived
notes: Where feasible, based on quintiles, where top 2 and bottom 2 are high and low.

label: Household-level SES
description: Socioeconomic status of the participant's household or family
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived
notes: Where feasible, based on within-study quintiles of the source measure, where top 2 and bottom 2 are high and low.

label: Household SES Measure Name
description: Source measure used to derive ses_household
missing_rule: Should not be missing when ses_household is available - using 'Unknown' as required
notes: Record the original measure, e.g. banded gross household income or Family Affluence Scale

label: Mother's education level
description: Mother's education level
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived

label: Father's education level
description: Father's education level
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived
notes: Mirror of maternal_education for the father or second parent/carer

label: Highest parental education level
description: Highest education level across the child's parents/carers
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived
notes: Derive as the higher of maternal_education and paternal_education where both exist; map directly when the study only records combined parental education

label: Urbanicity
description: Whether the participant lives in an urban or rural area
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived
notes: Preregistered covariate (regional location); collapse finer source categories (e.g., remoteness scales) onto these levels and document the recode

label: Family structure
description: Family structure of the household the child lives in (main home where the child has more than one)
missing_rule: Use Unknown if cannot be derived
notes: Two biological/adoptive parents = both resident parental figures are biological or adoptive parents; Step family = two resident parental figures with at least one biological/adoptive parent and at least one step-parent or parent's partner; Single parent = one resident parental figure with no co-resident partner; Other = no resident biological/adoptive parent (e.g., grandparent, foster, or institutional care); classify shared-care children by their main home where identifiable

label: School grade or year level
description: School grade or year level at the observation
notes: Record the source label (e.g., Year 7); mainly for sample description alongside age_years

label: Screen Time Measurement Type
description: Type of measure used for screen time
notes: Record the type of variable the original study used to capture screen time

label: Screen Time Measure Name
description: Name for screen time measure, if known or provided
missing_rule: Should not be missing - using 'Unknown' or 'Custom' as required

label: Screen Time Respondent
description: Who provided the screen time responses for this participant
allowed_values: Self|Parent or carer|Teacher|Device or objective measure|Other|Unknown
missing_rule: Use Unknown when screen time was collected but the source does not record who answered; use NA when no screen time was collected
notes: Vary by participant where the respondent changes with age (e.g. parent report for younger children, self-report for older) and record the age cut in variables.csv

label: Mental Health: Anxiety - anxiety scale (self-report)
description: Total score on the study's self-reported anxiety scale, where higher indicates more anxiety
notes: Generic row for studies that measure anxiety with a scale other than the named instruments, including short forms and item subsets. Record the instrument, item count and item scoring in mh_anx_measure and standardise within dataset at analysis rather than pooling raw totals. Studies with a full named instrument should use that row instead, and may populate both. Mirrors the beh_atten_self, beh_agg_self and wb_selfesteem_self pattern.

label: Mental Health: Anxiety measure

notes: Must carry enough detail to rescale the score later: name the instrument, how many items were scored, the per-item response range, and the resulting total range, e.g. 'Brief Symptom Inventory-18 anxiety subscale, 6 of 6 items, 1-4 item scoring (range 6-24)'. Note any reverse-scored items.
